problems.reason: The age range given for the Campanian stage (around 74 Ma) is inconsistent with the accepted geological timescale, where the Campanian is 83–72 Ma and 74 Ma falls in the Maastrichtian.

notes: - contradiction: "This dinosaur lived in South China during the Late Cretaceous, specifically in the Campanian stage around 74 million years ago, extending into the Maastrichtian stage between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.": The age range given for the Campanian stage (around 74 Ma) is inconsistent with the accepted geological timescale, where the Campanian is 83–72 Ma and 74 Ma falls in the Maastrichtian.
